loaderEvidence.fidelityBoundary: Exact 3DS point arrays, triangle faces, UVs, object names, material-face lists and referenced textures; deterministic Z-up→Y-up conversion. Runtime normals are recomputed because the preview does not reproduce 3DS smoothing-group splits.
